questions.explanation: The question is answerable only if enjoyment was recorded. Feelings are not automatically known or inherently unknowable.

questions.subject: SEMINAR
questions.learningObjective: Spot a question that presupposes its conclusion
questions.stem: In a sports club meeting, a member asks why the outdated rules harm members. What flaw does this contain?

options.text: It asks for too much data
It assumes the rules are outdated

questions.explanation: The question presupposes that the rules are outdated. It should first establish whether and why they are outdated.

questions.subject: SEMINAR
questions.learningObjective: Identify terms that need definition before research
questions.stem: In a sports club meeting, a member proposes measuring wellbeing. Which term needs a definition first?

options.text: The club colour, because it is fixed
The season length, because it is known
The sport, because it is obvious

questions.explanation: Wellbeing is broad and must be defined before measurement. The other items are already fixed or obvious.
